text.tspan: GDP per capita: Comparing data from World Bank and Penn World Table
This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Penn World Table data (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
World Bank data (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026); Feenstra et al. - Penn World Table (2025)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Penn World Table uses multiple benchmark years to adjust for differences in
living costs between countries over time. Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2018 and 2025 is
